description: Godot 4 game-development provider: live editor bridge (scene tree, nodes, scripts, signals, input map), headless script/boot checks, instrumented play sessions with screenshots and input scripting, procedural 3D asset generation (OBJ), Godot class-reference lookup, YouTube transcript watching, and asset-library discovery.

health.description: Read-only provider healthcheck: locates the Godot binary, confirms project.godot at targetRoot, and reports whether the editor bridge and runtime are reachable.

locate.description: Find the Godot executable (env ARES_GODOT, ~/.ares/godot.json, project .ares/godot.json, PATH, common install dirs) and report versions, bridge/runtime port status, and project facts.

install.description: Provision the engine: download the official Godot 4 release for this platform (optionally the .NET build), verify its SHA-512 against the published sums, extract it into the Ares home, and remember it. No-op when a matching engine already exists.

inspect.description: Observe project state without changing it: live scene tree via the editor bridge (or offline .tscn parse), node properties, project settings, input map, scripts, assets, signals.

mutate.description: Apply a batch of editor operations (scene new/open/save, node add/remove/set/reparent, script create/attach, signal connect, input-map actions, project settings). Uses the live editor bridge when available, otherwise edits .tscn/.gd/project.godot on disk.

check.description: Headless verification: parse-check every GDScript, boot the main scene for one frame under --headless, and collect SCRIPT ERROR / parse / missing-resource diagnostics.

run.description: Launch the game (or a specific scene) with the Ares runtime attached, execute an input/observation script (press actions, wait, query node state, screenshot), capture stdout/stderr errors, and save viewport screenshots as fresh visual evidence.

screenshot.description: Capture the editor's 3D or 2D viewport (via the bridge) or the running game's viewport (via the runtime) to a PNG and return it as fresh screenshot evidence.

asset.description: Generate 3D geometry procedurally (box, cylinder, cone, sphere, capsule, plane, terrain, lathe, extrude, stairs, ramp, arch) as Wavefront OBJ files Godot imports natively, or emit a @tool GDScript SurfaceTool generator.

docs.description: Fetch and cache Godot 4 class reference pages (docs.godotengine.org) as plain text, or search the cached corpus; also resolves tutorial pages by slug.

video.description: Watch a YouTube video by pulling its transcript (timestamped), or search YouTube for tutorials/reference footage; results are cached under the Ares home.

discover.description: Search reference and asset sources: Godot Asset Library API, Poly Haven models/textures/HDRIs, and a curated list of Godot learning sources.
